name: node-crawler
title: 节点爬虫（`crawler`包）
description: Node.js web crawler for production-grade, large-scale tasks — NOT for simple one-off requests. Use only when: bulk scraping, batch downloading, multi-page crawling, long-running spiders, or complex multi-step workflows that need connection pooling, rate limiting, proxy rotation, automatic retries, and Cheerio   parsing. Skip this for single pages or simple fetch — use `curl` instead. Triggers: scrape website at scale, crawl hundreds of pages, batch download files, web spider, data extraction from many URLs, crawl multiple pages with retries and proxies.
